rv.q: He surely would have reveled in this sweet “Aguardiente.”
Instead of trusting that idea to carry the work, it surrounds it with so much that it struggles to land.
Aguardiente is a musical that has a lot of noise at its core, and perhaps something heartfelt, too; but seldom is executed well enough to make it work.

cn.t: A vibrant celebration of Latin culture with spirited performances and Afro-Cuban music earns praise, but critics find the production hampered by weak execution, poor direction, and uneven staging that undermines its heartfelt intentions.
